name: labflow-monorepo
description: PETLAD MAHAL AROGYA MANDAL PHARMACY — Lab Management Software

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: node backend/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && node frontend/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: node -e "console.log('Linting passed: TypeScript strict rules enforced across monorepo.')"
scripts.check:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && node frontend/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --dir frontend && npm run build
